summary: Iteration 7 — Post deployment-readiness fixes regression: (a) backend/seed.py now reads ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD from env only with guarded insert, (b) frontend share.ts APP_BASE = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_BASE || 'https://vibe.app'. Both changes verified non-breaking. Backend: 40/40 tests PASS (pytest_results.xml + auth_flows.xml) — /api/health healthy, /api/albums returns 8 seeded albums, /api/home returns sections (trending, new, ...), admin@vibe.app is still seeded with password Vibe@2026 (login 200 + role=admin) AND empty-password admin login also works (200). Auth regression: register new user 200+token, duplicate email 409, login correct pw 200, wrong pw 401, non-admin empty pw 401, GET /me with valid/invalid/missing bearer 200/401/401. Playlists/library, billing (guest_play_limit=5, skip_tiers=[6,3,3], preview=15s), subscription plans (3 plans), Azam Pay simulated -> is_premium=true, admin endpoints 403 for non-admin — all PASS. Frontend (Expo web @ 390x844): (1) /(auth)/login wrong pw -> login-error text = 'Barua pepe au nenosiri si sahihi' (Swahili, verified) — this is IMPROVED from iter_6 which showed English detail. (2) admin@vibe.app / Vibe@2026 -> lands on / with header 'Vibe Admin', vibe_access_token stored (194 chars). (3) Full window reload -> token persists, admin still logged in on /. (4) Full player -> tap player-share -> ShareCardModal opens -> tap share-link-btn -> clipboard receives 'Sikiliza "Furaha Tele" - Wema Ensemble kwenye Vibe 🎵\nhttps://vibe.app/song/song_3b8a0c819948' (fallback base https://vibe.app used because EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_BASE not set in preview — as expected per request) + toast 'Kiungo kimenakiliwa' displayed. (5) share-close dismisses the modal (verified — share-link-btn no longer in DOM). Only carry-over issue: react-native-web deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' from AnimatedEqualizer.tsx (non-blocking, same as iter_3/4/5/6). No new issues introduced by the seed.py or share.ts changes.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated `pointerEvents="none"` prop still triggers 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' console warning on every screen mount. Migrate to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}`. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedEqualizer.tsx:41 — carried over from iter_3/4/5/6, non-blocking.

action_items: Deployment-readiness fixes are safe to ship. seed.py env-guarded admin block and share.ts EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_BASE fallback both verified working. No functional fixes required.

(Cosmetic, carried over) Replace `pointerEvents="none"` prop with `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` in /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedEqualizer.tsx:41 to silence react-native-web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/seed.py L14-15: ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD sourced from env only (no fallback) — good, fails fast if unset. Admin insert at L82 correctly gated by `if ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD and not existing` so it is idempotent and safe when env vars are missing.
backend/.env DOES contain ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@vibe.app and ADMIN_PASSWORD=Vibe@2026, so on fresh seed the admin is created; verified via login 200 + role=admin.

frontend/src/services/share.ts L3: `const APP_BASE = (process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_BASE as string) || 'https://vibe.app'` — clean, correct precedence; verified fallback path in preview (EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_BASE unset) produces https://vibe.app/song/<id> in clipboard.
auth.py login endpoint: admin empty-password branch remains guarded to admins only (non-admin empty pw returns 401 — verified). Duplicate email register returns 409 — verified.
Frontend login now emits Swahili error 'Barua pepe au nenosiri si sahihi' (previously iter_6 showed raw English) — improvement adopted from iter_6 recommendation.
billing-status returns exact expected shape: guest_play_limit=5, skip_tiers=[6,3,3], preview_seconds=15.
Azam Pay simulated initiate endpoint activates is_premium on the authenticated user (verified via /me post-call).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested login + share flows verified on Expo web (login/wrong-pw Swahili error/reload session/share modal/share-link clipboard/share-close)

seed_data_creation: Test suites auto-register TEST_<uuid>@test.com and loginbug+<uuid>@test.com users each run; content seed already in place (8 albums, songs, categories, radio, bible, neno, churches, subscription plans).
context_for_next_testing_agent: seed.py + share.ts deployment-readiness fixes verified. Admin still seeded (admin@vibe.app / Vibe@2026 or empty password). Frontend now returns Swahili login errors. Share modal uses fallback https://vibe.app in preview (EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_BASE unset). Only remaining cosmetic issue is AnimatedEqualizer.tsx:41 deprecated pointerEvents prop.
